sectors.name: Pit straight and T1–3
sectors.observed: Long white pit buildings face a covered red crowd stand, with bright paired floodlights and yellow pit-edge paint. The first complex has close mesh fences, individual red-white kerbs and paved escape lanes. The mapped pit footprint is on the driver left near native station 4896.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Republic Boulevard T4–5
sectors.observed: The Republic Boulevard walls and mesh sit close to the asphalt. Palms, broadleaf crowns and pale modern facades appear behind them. Long rows of floodlights continue overhead. Urban road markings and paved verges should remain visible.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Raffles Boulevard T6–7
sectors.observed: Glass office and hotel facades have repeated window mullions. Large yellow hatched junctions, city lamps and close barriers define Raffles Boulevard. Millenia, Suntec and Marina Square use their mapped positions, with trees breaking up the building walls.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Stamford and Padang T8–9
sectors.observed: The Old City Hall colonnade and former Supreme Court give the Padang section its pale civic architecture. A broad lawn and mature tree canopy sit behind close fencing. Low cricket and recreation clubs face them. Kerbs and yellow junction marks remain distinct.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Anderson Bridge and Fullerton hairpin
sectors.observed: Anderson Bridge has narrow masonry edges and balustrades. Fullerton and the Waterboat House frame the riverfront turns, with heavy cornices, tall bays and trees. Escape areas remain paved beside these river walls.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Esplanade Drive and Connaught
sectors.observed: Esplanade Drive and Connaught are broad paved streets beside grandstands and dense trees. The two spiked Esplanade shells sit beyond the route, with tall office towers and distant marina buildings above the floodlights. Asphalt and wall bases must stay readable at night.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: New waterfront straight and NS Square bypass
sectors.observed: Modern NS Square bypass/waterfront straight, continuous urban fencing and overhead race-light strings.1250.81s directly shows the Singapore Flyer rim/capsule ring ahead above the road; its white capsule points contrast with a dark rim/sky. Preserve the current19-turn layout without the removed old grandstand tunnel sequence.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Final corners and pit complex
sectors.observed: The Flyer wheel, low retail base, pit entry and terraces frame the final corners. Bright lights, compact red-white kerbs and yellow paved edges lead back to the white pit roof and main stand. Protection should follow the final curves continuously.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

flyer_reference_registration.observed: The circular rim and distinct white capsule points are directly visible ahead above the waterfront straight. The rim is dark against the night sky; do not substitute a uniformly glowing neon circle.
flyer_reference_registration.geographic_check: At native4100m the mapped wheel is373m forward and2m right of the source tangent, matching its near-central forward skyline view. By4480m it is only37m forward and82m left, mostly outside the horizontal/vertical cockpit FOV. Capture earlier on the straight.
